sense.text:
“Woe unto them that seek deep to hide their counsel from the Lord, and their works are in the dark.” This is Esau, the so-called white man: America in particular, and her allies with her. They do a lot of evil in the world, and because of their media they really believe nobody is going to figure out that they are the wicked, that they are the terrorists the scriptures speak of.

“And they say, Who seeth us? and who knoweth us?” A man on the news had to break it down to the lowest common denominator for white people: if I show up at your door after your family has lived there a hundred years, put a gun to your head and say get out, this is my house because my religion says so, and then fire an RPG at your house when you throw rocks, which of us is the terrorist? White people really believe in that Manifest Destiny. When we get that power, talk time is over.

precepts.why:
“When thou sawest a thief, then thou consentedst with him.” America has consented with the Israelis over the stealing of land, because America is based upon the stealing of land. The same with Britain, the same with Australia and the South Africans: they steal, kill and destroy. Palestine was stolen, in the thirties and forties, and they are still stealing: Gaza, the West Bank, Lebanon, and they will try to get Jordan too.

“And hast been partaker with adulterers”: they sleep with the people they conquer, raping the women.

“Thou givest thy mouth to evil, and thy tongue frameth deceit.” They lie consistently. A Zionist woman in Paris and her daughter were caught on police cameras painting the anti-Semitic graffiti they kept reporting on their own door. Every Passover in New York there is a so-called bomb threat and the police have to sit outside their synagogues; nobody is making those threats but themselves.

“Behold, his soul which is lifted up is not upright in him.” You cannot Christianize the white man, you cannot Judaize him; there is nothing you can do to fix him. “But the just shall live by his faith”: we are the just, and living by his faith means living by Christ.

“He transgresseth by wine”: his wine is his philosophy, his politics. “He is a proud man, neither keepeth at home”: he does not stay home. He has over 845 military bases in everybody’s country. “Who enlargeth his desire as hell, and is as death”: wherever this man goes he turns that place into hell on earth. He “cannot be satisfied”: give him a little and he takes more and more.

“But gathereth unto him all nations, and heapeth unto him all people”: once he brings hell and death to a nation, he gathers its remnant to his own country, the way people from Iraq, Afghanistan and Palestine are here today. That is the “thick clay” he ladeth himself with. “Woe to him that increaseth that which is not his!” Palestine is not his, just as Australia, America, Britain and South Africa were not his.

“Shall they not rise up suddenly that shall bite thee, and awake that shall vex thee”: the nations he made a hell on earth will rise up out of sleep, like sleeper cells, and vex him with explosions and destruction. People ask why the nations hate America so much; verse 8 tells you: “Because thou hast spoiled many nations, all the remnant of the people shall spoil thee; because of men’s blood, and for the violence of the land.” That is the judgment of God toward the white man. Already all of Jordan is saying they are Hamas: you genocide a people and think their brothers will not retaliate. Bible prophecy is underway.

sense.text:
“And I beheld another beast coming up out of the earth”: this is the United States of America.

“He had two horns like a lamb”: they portray themselves as Christian, saying we follow Christ, in God we trust. And the two horns are the Republicans and the Democrats, the two-party system.

“And he spake as a dragon”: those are the great words. A Christian country, and in its infant stages it instituted slavery; white women, even single white women, were buying us on the slave auction. They say in God we trust, but we are going to enslave God’s people and destroy God’s people. Those are the great words spoken against the Most High.

precepts.why:
Daniel’s little horn is the same beast that had two horns like a lamb. “Before whom there were three of the first horns plucked up by the roots”: when America established herself she plucked up the Spanish, the French and the British, through the French American war, the war of independence and the Spanish American war, and the remnants of those nations that were here came together and formed the United States of America.

“In this horn were eyes like the eyes of man”: they have vision, great visions. “And a mouth speaking great things”: blasphemy, their media.

“I beheld till the thrones were cast down”: Daniel sees the kingdoms of the earth destroyed. “And the Ancient of days did sit, whose garment was white as snow”: to sit and to have on a garment you must have a body. “And the hair of his head like the pure wool”: afro hair. God is a black man. We do not care if you get upset. “His throne was like the fiery flame, and his wheels as burning fire”: his wheels and his chariots are what they now call UAPs.

“A fiery stream issued and came forth from before him: thousand thousands ministered unto him, and ten thousand times ten thousand stood before him.” Tens of thousands of angels worshipping and glorifying him: you cannot just roll up on the Most High because you say you have a personal relationship with him. “The judgment was set, and the books were opened”: the Bible, and the books on our lives.

Then Daniel goes back to the horn of verse 8: “I beheld then because of the voice of the great words which the horn spake: I beheld even till the beast was slain, and his body destroyed, and given to the burning flame.” He calls the horn a beast, the same as Revelation. The great words of the horn, “a mouth speaking great things”, are what Revelation means when the beast “spake as a dragon.” And his end is destruction.

“And thy heaven that is over thy head shall be brass, and the earth that is under thee shall be iron.” It is twofold. Yes, it means no blessings on us from heaven or on earth. But it also happened literally: when we were runaway slaves they put brass bells over our heads, and we had iron shackles on our ankles. That is the beast speaking as a dragon.

Looking at those images of slavery you always have to ask a Christian: where was John 3:16? “For God so loved the world”: where was the love?

The white folks’ church never included us in that verse until after the Civil Rights era, after 1964, because before that we were not allowed in their churches. Now black people got their little freedom, their civil rights, and say God so loved the world, my brother. During Jim Crow there was no John 3:16 for us.

“There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither bond nor free, there is neither male nor female: for ye are all one in Christ Jesus.” Where was this verse when we were in chains?

Ask a Christian what the Greeks look like: white. What the Jews look like: white. Then where does the Negro fit in that verse according to them? You are not included in that verse. In terms of Christianity, that use of Galatians 3 is hogwash.

sense.text:
After all those great words spoken against the Most High, a Negro comes up with the idea that black people need a covenant with America. But during Jim Crow there was no John 3:16 for us, and this is what Solomon saw.

“So I returned, and considered all the oppressions that are done under the sun”: Solomon saw visions of all the oppressions done on all the earth. “And behold the tears of such as were oppressed”: that is the Israelites; he saw the Israelites being oppressed. “And they had no comforter.”

“And on the side of their oppressors there was power”: on the side of the white man, our oppressors. They have financial power, military power, political power, nuclear power. We do not have nothing. “But they had no comforter.”

“We would have healed Babylon, but she is not healed.” This is black people. Black people, then and now, always had the mentality to heal Babylon. You cannot heal Babylon, just as they could not heal it back then. It does not matter how many covenants and agreements you make with white America, the Covenant with Black America: it is not going to happen.

“Forsake her, and let us go every one into his own country”: a future prophecy.

Now Trump comes in and tries to heal America his own way. The first thing he did was tell federal employees to remove their pronouns by the end of the day. Make America great again is talk about slavery: he wants to restore her to the good old days when white was right. His purge of DEI programs has black leaders pissed off, and civil rights advancements are being rolled back. If you are the only black person in your office, you are possibly a DEI hire, and you will be losing that job. We told black people for years the Most High is going to turn the heat up in this country, and black Christians mocked us, called us conspiracy theorists, crazy, a cult. Now reality is setting in.

Ephraim and Esau put Trump in office; the bulk of the votes were Edom and Ephraim, men and women. The same black folks and Latinos who said Democrats are no damn good are now getting thrown out of the country.

Federal agencies now bar Black History Month and the other special observances. Kwanzaa is gone, Martin Luther King Day is gone, Juneteenth is gone.

Here is the problem: “Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, Concerning the feasts of the Lord, which ye shall proclaim to be holy convocations, even these are my feasts.” In this chapter the Lord gives us a list of holidays, but black and Latino people do not want to keep them. We say give me Martin Luther King Day, give me Juneteenth, give me Kwanzaa, give me anything black, but do not give me that Bible.

So God put somebody in office who said to hell with all your nigger holidays: we do not respect them and we do not respect you. Now the Christians have their lips stuck out, but it is all of the Lord. The Lord is forcing our people: you are going to come back and do what I say, or you are going to die.

The same goes for the executive orders on critical race theory and on the college protesters: the black people who joined the protests against Israel are going to get a rude awakening, and so are the sisters on Section 8 who say they do not need a man. We are on God’s side, not theirs. These are examples of the beast speaking as a dragon.

“And he exerciseth all the power of the first beast before him”: America exercises all the power of Rome, the first beast before him. This is an extension of the Roman Empire. You think this is a land of freedom, milk and honey; you are going to find out this is ancient Rome back again.

“Whose deadly wound was healed”: during the Renaissance the wound was healed. Rome came back during the Renaissance.

“So that he maketh fire come down from heaven on the earth in the sight of men”: World War II, the two atom bombs dropped on Hiroshima and Nagasaki. When they talk about blacks killing blacks, drop the stats on Hiroshima and Nagasaki, and on Gaza. Whatever we do to each other is nothing compared to the evil and devastation white folks have done. We do evil, but they are the devil.

“And deceiveth them that dwell on the earth by the means of those miracles which he had power to do in the sight of the beast”: in the sight of his European allies.

“That they should make an image to the beast”: this is Christianity. “Which had the wound by a sword, and did live”: the image they chose honors Rome. That image of Jesus, white Jesus, honors ancient Rome.

precepts.why:
We tried to warn black Christians. During the blitzes we contacted the preachers to sit down and organize the people as Israelites, because danger was coming. They gave us the finger, pulled guns on us, called the cops, attacked us with shoes and belts.

“And the Lord shall bring thee into Egypt again with ships”: we came to America, the spiritual Egypt, on slave ships. “By the way whereof I spake unto thee”: the way God said it would happen is the way it happened.

“And there ye shall be sold unto your enemies”: once we got off those ships we were sold. Highlight that word: enemies, not friends. Christians hate this verse and try to debunk it with new doctrines, saying we are crazy. “For bondmen and bondwomen”: slave men and slave women. “And no man shall buy you”: no man shall save or redeem us.

The Christians on TikTok and Instagram who make video after video calling the Israelites stupid, crazy, jailbirds, and the preachers who cursed us out from the pulpit, now see what is happening in society. It is only going to get worse for black, brown and Latin people. Even Jamal Bryant said one thing right: the Hebrew Israelites have the discipline to study and know that book.

sense.text:
A Mexican brother said the Catholic Church is the true church of Jesus Christ and that what we teach about the Pope and slavery is false. Look up Pope Nicholas V. We looked it up: The Critical Review, or Annals of Literature, published in 1783, says Pope Nicholas V, in that famous bull by which he granted the unknown world to the Portuguese and Spaniards, expressly permitted and ordered the Christians to reduce all infidels into slavery, and both those nations zealously executed it. Christians do no studying, but they are quick to say something is not true.

“For what if some did not believe? shall their unbelief make the faith of God without effect?” What if some of you do not believe, like our Mexican brother and the hundreds on TikTok? Is that going to change a single thing the Bible says? No.
“God forbid: yea, let God be true, but every man a liar.” Let the Bible be true, the way we teach it, and let every one of the rest of you be a liar.

“And there was given unto him a mouth speaking great things and blasphemies”: this white man is the one with the great mouth, the same as when he spake as a dragon. “And power was given unto him to continue forty and two months”: this is done in the context of Rome. The Christian Roman Catholic Church is still in view.

“And he opened his mouth in blasphemy against God, to blaspheme his name”: he blasphemes the Lord’s name. “And his tabernacle”: he blasphemed us. “And them that dwell in heaven”: he blasphemed the angels.

“And it was given unto him to make war with the saints, and to overcome them”: they made war with us and overcame us. That is what slavery was about, what the slave books show, and what Revelation 13 is describing. “And power was given him over all kindreds, and tongues, and nations.”

“And all that dwell upon the earth shall worship him”: everybody on this earth is worshipping this white man as God and as Christ, even the brown-skinned Indians worship this white man as Jesus. “Whose names are not written in the book of life of the Lamb.”

In the Pillory: The Tale of the Borgia Pope, published in 1927, says it is an open secret that Caesar Borgia, the son of Pope Alexander VI, posed for the bust of San Salvatore, Saint Savior. Their own writers asked whether there was not one Cardinal to tell their criminal colleague that he was not the Vicar of Christ but the Antichrist; vicar means replacement, so they call the Pope Christ on earth. Caesar Borgia, his sister Lucrezia and Pope Alexander VI himself appear in the frescoes of the Vatican, and in the Last Supper Caesar Borgia sits in the center as Christ, with Rodrigo Borgia and Lucrezia among the twelve.

Their scholars know who that image is. It is black people and Latinos who do not know, and some will kill you over it: they threw bricks and hot water at a captain in Queens to make him stop preaching against it. Many of the ten tribes, and some of you Negroes, are bowing down worshipping these demons. That is what Revelation 13:7-8 has been talking about.

passages.opened: Song of the Three Holy Children 1:3-10

sense.text: What the three Hebrews said about Babylon was true back then and is truer for us today. “Blessed art thou, O Lord God of our fathers”: they are in the fire, going through tribulation. It is what Spain called the auto de fe, the act of faith: during the Spanish Inquisition they burned the Black Moors and the black Jews alive if they did not become Christian. They got that from Babylon: if you did not worship Nebuchadnezzar’s idol, he threw you in the fire.

“For thou art righteous in all the things that thou hast done to us.” Imagine it: they are in the fire, and they say you are righteous for all you have done to us. This is what black and Latino Christians need to understand: everything that has happened to us in this country and wherever we are scattered, God is just. Slavery, tribulation, persecution, mutilation: we have deserved it and more. “True are all thy works, thy ways are right, and all thy judgments truth.”

“Thou hast executed true judgment.” It was prophesied that if we broke the laws this would happen; our people did not believe it, and we suffered the consequences. “For according to truth and judgment didst thou bring all these things upon us because of our sins.”

“For we have sinned and committed iniquity, departing from thee.” This is what many of our people will not confess. Christians will not take any accountability for what our forefathers did: we did not do nothing.
“In all things have we trespassed”: we broke all the commandments. “That it might go well with us”: that we might stay in the promised land.

“Thou hast done in true judgment. And thou didst deliver us into the hands of lawless enemies.” If you thought ancient Babylon was lawless, this place is way worse: this is Babylon the great. At least back then we knew our identity, our own language and customs; this place destroyed everything from us.

“Most hateful forsakers of God”: what is worse, they have the Bible but will not obey it. “And to an unjust king, and the most wicked in all the world”: this place, the most wicked in all the world.

“And in the latter time of their kingdom”: the latter time of Rome, the fourth kingdom, which is America. “A king of fierce countenance, and understanding dark sentences, shall stand up.” This is not one man. The presidency changes every four years and the Pope retires or dies in office, so it is impossible for this to be one guy. It is a race of man.

“Understanding dark sentences”: they understand the scriptures to an extent.

“And his power shall be mighty, but not by his own power”: they got their power from Satan. You thought they got all that technology because they are smarter than everybody; no, evil spirits are working with them.

“And shall destroy the mighty and the holy people”: they enslaved us and destroyed us. That is what Revelation 13:7-8 and Deuteronomy 28:68 were saying.

“And through his policy also”: his politics, his philosophies. “He shall cause craft to prosper in his hand”: science. “And he shall magnify himself in his heart”: with all this power I am God, that is what this white man is saying.

“And by peace shall destroy many”: Trump comes up with ideas to make peace on earth, the Pope creates peace initiatives, and they work together.

“He shall also stand up against the Prince of princes”: this white man shall stand up against Christ. “But he shall be broken without hand”: Christ is going to destroy him.

The Rise of Christendom, published in 1890, says the medieval chroniclers state expressly that Edom means the Roman Empire or the European powers, and that Benjamin of Tudela, about 1160, called Rome the Edomite capital and the Pope the head of the Edomite religion. So whether you are Baptist, Episcopalian or Methodist, you fall under the Pope and the Edomite religion he heads. The scholars always knew Rome and Europe is Edom; it is Christians today who say Edom was destroyed.

precepts.why:
“That thou shalt take up this proverb against the king of Babylon”: the king of Babylon is America. It is not talking about just Trump, just Clinton or just Ronald Reagan, but all of them.

“How hath the oppressor ceased! the golden city ceased!” The oppressor is not one man; the oppressor is the entire country, the entire nation. The king of Babylon is called the golden city, and a city is not one guy. That is why the king of fierce countenance in Daniel 8 is a race, not a single ruler.

“And I saw one of his heads as it were wounded to death”: Rome. “And his deadly wound was healed”: the Renaissance. “And all the world wondered after the beast”: after the white man.

“And they worshipped the dragon which gave power unto the beast”: they worshipped the devil, who gave power to the white man. Sometimes you have to sit back and ask how this white man came up with all these technological advancements, how he went to the moon, how he created weaponry like no other race on the planet. It is not that they are smarter than anybody. The dragon showed them how to make a firecracker into a Hiroshima. That is what “not by his own power” means.

“And the devil, taking him up into an high mountain, shewed unto him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time.” Not only the kingdoms of that time: in a moment, in a thought, he showed him every kingdom from that time all the way to this time.

“All this power will I give thee, and the glory of them: for that is delivered unto me.” That power was delivered to Satan in the garden. “And to whomsoever I will I give it.”

The stipulation is verse 7: “If thou therefore wilt worship me, all shall be thine.” Now we know how the white man got all his power: they worship the devil. Christ revealed it right there.

sense.text:
The Pope wants all Christian leaders to accept a common date for Easter to unite all Christians, and the Abrahamic Family House in Abu Dhabi, a mosque, a synagogue and a church together, is already open: three religions uniting as one. That is the peace initiative they want to bring about, and that is why they are going to make the Bible, at least the way we teach it, illegal. You can say God loves the world, but saying the world is our people will be illegal, because they say it fosters a racist narrative that God is only for one race. Which he is.

“And ye shall know that I am in the midst of Israel, and that I am the Lord your God, and none else.” He is the God of Israel and none else. Get mad if you want; it does not make a hill of beans to us.

precepts.why:
Now what are the Christians going to do with the New Testament? “And so all Israel shall be saved.” He did not say everybody on the planet; he said all Israel, meaning the elect of Israel.

“There shall come out of Sion the Deliverer”: that is Christ. “And shall turn away ungodliness from Jacob.” He died for us; he did not die for everybody. That is what the Bible says, and they are going to make reading it like that illegal.

sense.text:
“In those days went there out of Israel wicked men, who persuaded many”: back then, just as now, there will always be wicked men and women among us.

“Let us go and make a covenant with the heathen that are round about us”: make a covenant with the white man. That is what Tavis Smiley’s book, the Covenant with Black America, is about: getting America to make an agreement with black America. “For since we departed from them we have had much sorrow”: if we are not around white folks, things always go bad for us.
“So this device pleased them well”: it pleased the wicked well.
“Who gave them licence to do after the ordinances of the heathen”: we wanted to be just like the heathen nations.

“And forsook the holy covenant, and joined themselves to the heathen, and were sold to do mischief.” We wanted to be sinful just like the white man; we did not want to keep the commandments anymore. That was the state back then, and it applies to our people today.

precepts.why:
“And that which cometh into your mind shall not be at all, that ye say, We will be as the heathen.” Our people always want to be like the white man, like the other nations; we want to be everybody but who we are, the children of Israel.

“As the families of the countries, to serve wood and stone”: we want to worship idols just like everybody else. That is the mentality of Christians and Muslims.

sense.text:
“Because ye have said, We have made a covenant with death, and with hell are we at agreement.” This death is the same death read at the beginning of the lesson in Habakkuk 2, where this man is as death, enlarges his desire as hell, and cannot be satisfied. It is the same guy. We want to make an agreement with the white man.

“When the overflowing scourge shall pass through, it shall not come unto us”: when judgment and destruction come to this nation. Christians think when the Lord comes they will be saved, that there will be no destruction and Christ will just come and kiss and love everybody.

“For we have made lies our refuge, and under falsehood have we hid ourselves”: lie after lie. The Immaculate Conception, a lie; Christmas, a lie; white Jesus, a lie; Mother’s Day and Father’s Day, lies. Everything in Christianity and Islam is a lie.

That is our wanting to be like the nations: the white man says I will make you governors, mayors, city councilmen, and let’s see what you do. Then comes the brawl at the Thornton Township meeting, and the same people go and pray. There can be no true unity among our people without the word of God, keeping the commandments as Israelites. And you do not think the white folks in government see that and say this is the DEI we have been talking about?

“He that believeth shall not make haste.” If you believe in this, you will not leave this truth. You will not be hasty to say I am going back to Islam, back to Christianity, back to my suit and tie, to hell with the fringes.
“And the hail shall sweep away the refuge of lies”: destruction is going to come whether Christians accept it or not.

“And your covenant with death shall be disannulled”: your covenant with the white man. “And your agreement with hell shall not stand”: whatever agreement you have with America shall not stand. “Then ye shall be trodden down by it”: God is telling the Christians you are going to die in that lying Christianity.

“And it shall be a vexation only to understand the report.” Once we teach this truth and the Christians and others hear it, it is going to vex them, because they will know what we have been saying all these years is true. The report is our teaching. They might say to hell with it, but when they go home and watch the news, they will say this is what they have been talking about.

precepts.why:
The precious corner stone of Isaiah 28 is explained here. “And are built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets”: that is how we are built up. “Jesus Christ himself being the chief corner stone.”

“In whom all the building fitly framed together”: we are the building. Fitly framed together means work together, gather yourselves together. Everyone play your position, play your role, play your rank; stay in order. “Groweth unto an holy temple in the Lord”: if we roll in that spirit, we are going to grow into a holy temple.

sense.text:
We want to be like the heathen and make a covenant with death and hell; now this is the result of it. King Antiochus, of the Seleucid dynasty, Antiochus IV, was a wicked, wicked man. Everything about him is real and it did happen, but as many commentaries on Daniel say, the Bible uses his life metaphorically for the last days, the last empire.

“That all should be one people”: this sounds just like America.

“And every one should leave his laws: so all the heathen agreed according to the commandment of the king. Yea, many also of the Israelites consented to his religion.” They call their politics religion: democracy and Christianity are one and the same. “And sacrificed unto idols, and profaned the sabbath.”

“That they should follow the strange laws of the land, and forbid burnt offerings”: they made up new feast days, just like here in America with Kwanzaa and Martin Luther King Day. “That they should profane the sabbaths and festival days”: do not keep it, teach that it is done away with, just like today.
“And sacrifice swine’s flesh”: they even sacrificed swine’s flesh on the temple altar.
“To the end they might forget the law, and change all the ordinances.” That is the purpose of changing all of God’s ordinances: so that we might forget God’s law.
“And whosoever would not do according to the commandment of the king, he said, he should die.” That sounds oddly familiar: it is exactly what Revelation 13:15 says will happen prophetically.

“And appointed overseers over all the people”: a lot of these overseers were our own people, just as ancient Egypt set taskmasters. “Then many of the people were gathered unto them, to wit every one that forsook the law.” This is the same thing Christ warned us about in Matthew 10.
“They set up the abomination of desolation upon the altar”: they put the image of Zeus on the altar and sacrificed swine on it. “And builded idol altars throughout the cities of Juda on every side.”

“And when they had rent in pieces the books of the law which they found, they burnt them with fire.” They started tearing up and burning the Bibles.

“And whosoever was found with any the book of the testament”: a scribe’s job was to write out a copy of Isaiah or whatever book you paid for. Whoever was found with it, or kept God’s law, “the king’s commandment was, that they should put him to death.” You think that could never happen in America. You are so mistaken.

precepts.why:
“And he had power to give life unto the image of the beast, that the image of the beast should both speak, and cause that as many as would not worship the image of the beast should be killed.” It is the same thing as Antiochus’ commandment that whoever would not obey should die.

That is why Paul said the things written aforetime were written for our learning. The church says that was in the past; no, it is very relevant, because the things that occurred back then shall occur again.

“I will liken my judgment unto a ring”: it goes around and it does not stop. “Like as there is no slackness of the last, even so there is no swiftness of the first.” It all goes in order, around and around. What Antiochus did comes around again in the beast of Revelation 13.

“And they shall be upon thee for a sign and for a wonder, and upon thy seed for ever.” The curses of God shall be upon us for a sign and a wonder. How long? For ever.

It did not stop in Assyria, in Babylon, or with Persia and Media. Christians say the curses of God stopped with Rome; for ever does not mean it stopped with Rome. All the death and devastation that has happened to our people is a continual cycle of the curses God put on us, and it is not going to stop; it is only going to get worse.

“For whatsoever things were written aforetime”: the judgments, the curses that would come upon us until Christ returns. “Were written for our learning”: we are supposed to learn from the mistakes of our forefathers and not make the same mistakes again.

“That we through patience and comfort of the scriptures might have hope”: because we are reading, studying and applying what we read, we say I am not going to make that mistake, because I see what happened. Our people in the church just do not get it.

sense.text: When you read Habakkuk it is talking about Babylon and the Chaldeans. One of the first empires, under Nimrod, was Babylon. Yes, it occurred under Nebuchadnezzar, but it is twofold, because it is also talking about the daughter of Babylon.

“O Lord, how long shall I cry, and thou wilt not hear! even cry out unto thee of violence.” “Therefore the law is slacked, and judgment doth never go forth”: just like back then, so it is today; the law is slacked in this land.

“For the wicked doth compass about the righteous”: the wicked is Edom, and they compass us about on every side. “Therefore wrong judgment proceedeth.” They are trying to get the man who killed George Floyd out of prison, saying how innocent he is. Rob a store and the cashier has a heart attack, and we get charged with felony murder; five people died in the January 6 Capitol invasion, two of them cops, and nobody got a felony murder charge. A dying declaration naming who would kill him was not allowed to be used. Kendrick Johnson was rolled up in the carpet with cameras all over the gym, his organs removed, and the family of the Edomite who worked with the FBI sued his family. Certain laws only apply to blacks and Latinos. Black people, do not forget.
“For I will work a work in your days, which ye will not believe, though it be told you.” The Lord said I am going to do something you will not even believe.

“For, lo, I raise up the Chaldeans”: yes, it was Nebuchadnezzar then, but now the Chaldeans are a metaphor for Edom, because they are the daughter of the Chaldeans. “That bitter and hasty nation, which shall march through the breadth of the land”: they went from South America all the way up. “To possess the dwellingplaces that are not theirs”: did not the white man do that? Babylon did it back then, and they did it too.

“Their horses also are swifter than the leopards”: they came with horses, and the horses had armor. “They shall fly as the eagle that hasteth to eat”: they are birds of prey.

Chosen People from the Caucasus, written by Michael Bradley, an Edomite, says what is not in any popular history of the Jewish people and has never been taught in the public schools: that Jews were major participants in the genocide of the American Indians as conquistadors, and in the transatlantic trade in Africans as slaves, with estimates from ten to fifteen million victims and as high as a hundred million. These were the converts to Judaism who joined the conquistadors when the Inquisition came. White folks know who they are. Those damn conquistadors were Amalek.

“They shall come all for violence.” Why did they come to America, to Central America, to Mexico, to South America, to Australia, to South Africa? For violence. All means all of them: not some nice and some violent; the men, the women and the babies, all of them violent.

“Their faces shall sup up as the east wind”: they came from the east. “And they shall gather the captivity as the sand”: they gathered our people as the sand; we are the captivity.

“And they shall scoff at the kings”: they scoffed at Montezuma. “They shall deride every strong hold”: every stronghold they found among the Aztecs, the Incas and the Native Americans, they destroyed.

“For they shall heap dust, and take it”: they heap confusion. The dust they heaped was Christianity, God so loved the world, and with that dust they took North America, Mexico, Central and South America, Australia and South Africa.

“Then shall his mind change”: I want to be more Christian, more civil; I will let you into my government, you can go up in the little churches now, you are already broken. “And he shall pass over, and offend”: he is still going to offend. “Imputing this his power unto his god”: his god is Satan, not the God of the Bible; see that little g. Primarily he sees himself as God.
“O Lord, thou hast ordained them for judgment; and, O mighty God, thou hast established them for correction.” God ordained this white man for judgment, and established him for our correction.

precepts.why:
“Remember, O Lord, the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem”: the children of Edom are the white man. This is David speaking prophetically: it did not happen in David’s time, but he saw the destruction of Jerusalem. “Who said, Rase it, rase it, even to the foundation thereof”: Edom wanted us destroyed.

“O daughter of Babylon”: David calls Edom the daughter of Babylon. That is why Habakkuk is twofold: it happened under Nebuchadnezzar, but it is also talking about the daughter of Babylon.

“But unto the wicked God saith”: the wicked is Edom. “What hast thou to do to declare my statutes”: they try to declare God’s word. “Or that thou shouldest take my covenant in thy mouth”: one group takes the old covenant and calls itself Jewish, another takes the new covenant and calls itself Christian.

“Seeing thou hatest instruction, and castest my words behind thee”: both groups hate the instruction of God and cast his words behind them. They will not obey.

“When thou sawest a thief, then thou consentedst with him”: when they see thieves stealing nations and countries, they agree with it, and give them weapons to fight people throwing rocks. “Thou givest thy mouth to evil”: they lie. And “speakest against thy brother”: that is us. That is the wicked that compasses about the righteous in Habakkuk 1:4.

“Thus saith the Lord God concerning Edom”: Edom means red, the red people. “Behold, I have made thee small among the heathen: thou art greatly despised.”

“Thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock”: that is where the word Caucasian comes from, the Caucasus mountains of Georgia and Russia. “Whose habitation is high”: they live in skyscrapers. “That saith in his heart, Who shall bring me down to the ground?” To say that you have to have power: nuclear, military, conventional, financial and political power.

“Though thou exalt thyself as the eagle”: Edom’s symbol is the eagle. The United States’ symbol is the eagle, as it was for Spain, Rome, France and, at one time, Britain. “And though thou set thy nest among the stars”: in case you are still being stupid, they are doing space travel. It is not Nebuchadnezzar doing space travel; it is the white man. So the Chaldeans of Habakkuk 1:8 who “fly as the eagle” are Edom.

God ordaining this white man for judgment is the same thing Romans 9 says. Paul starts at verse 13 talking about Esau, and compares Esau to Pharaoh in verse 17: “Even for this same purpose have I raised thee up.” God raised up Pharaoh the same way he raised up Esau.

Why did he allow the white man all his technological advancements? “That I might shew my power in thee”: God has to show everybody that only he can take this man down. “And that my name might be declared throughout all the earth”: everybody is going to declare the one true God’s name throughout all the earth.

“Therefore hath he mercy on whom he will have mercy, and whom he will he hardeneth.”

“What if God, willing to shew his wrath, and to make his power known, endured with much longsuffering the vessels of wrath fitted to destruction.” Fitted means created: they were created for destruction, for that purpose. You are not going to save them by getting them to believe. That is what Habakkuk 1:12 means when it says “thou hast ordained them for judgment.”

sense.text:
The lesson is Trump and the Epiphanes complex. Epiphanes is Greek for manifest; it is supposed to be God manifest, the Glorious, an epithet borne by several Hellenistic rulers. This is the same Antiochus of 1 Maccabees 1.

“About that time came Antiochus with dishonour out of the country of Persia”: he went to rob the temple at Persepolis, the people put him to flight, and he “returned with shame.”

“He thought to avenge upon the Jews the disgrace done unto him by those that made him flee.” He had to run from the other nations, so he said I am going to take it out on Israel. “That he would come to Jerusalem and make it a common burying place of the Jews”: this devil swore he would destroy Jerusalem. That is how evil he was.

“But the Lord Almighty” struck him “with an incurable and invisible plague”, “a pain of the bowels that was remediless”: inside his guts he was getting jacked up. “And that most justly: for he had tormented other men’s bowels with many and strange torments.” He used to torture Israelites, so God said I am going to torture this devil.

“Howbeit he nothing at all ceased from his bragging”: he always bragged, which is why he took the name Epiphanes, God manifest on earth. “But still was filled with pride, breathing out fire in his rage against the Jews.”

“He that a little afore thought he might command the waves of the sea”: that is how prideful he was, he thought he could command the ocean. Now he was cast on the ground, “shewing forth unto all the manifest power of God.”

“So that the worms rose up out of the body of this wicked man”: he had worms coming out of his body, his flesh fell away, and “no man could endure to carry for his intolerable stink.” What kind of disease is that, when you stink so bad people cannot be near you?

“Being plagued, he began to leave off his great pride”: see what judgment will do; the scourge of God puts you back in your right frame of mind. “When he himself could not abide his own smell”: you know you stink when you cannot stand your own smell.

Then, as evil as he is, this white man says “It is meet to be subject unto God, and that a man that is mortal should not proudly think of himself if he were God.” Now he is starting to get it.
“This wicked person vowed also unto the Lord, who now no more would have mercy upon him.” He vowed that the holy city he was hurrying to lay even with the ground “he would set at liberty.”

The Jews he had persecuted, whom he had judged not worthy to be buried, “he would make them all equals to the citizens of Athens”: I will give the Jews citizenship equal to white folks. He would garnish the temple he had spoiled and desecrated, and pay for the sacrifices “out of his own revenue”, out of his own pocket. Lord, if you let me live, I will do this for the Jews.

“Yea, and that also he would become a Jew himself, and go through all the world that was inhabited, and declare the power of God.” He repented so much he said I will convert, I will be like a Jew; this white man said I will preach the gospel.
“But for all this his pains would not cease: for the just judgment of God was come upon him.” For all that he promised the Lord, his pain would not go away.

He wrote “to the good Jews his citizens”, wishing them all the blessings in the world, saying he had his hope in heaven, and asking them to be faithful to him and to his son Antiochus, whom he appointed king. If the daddy is a devil, the son is a devil too.

“Thus the murderer and blasphemer having suffered most grievously, as he entreated other men, so died he a miserable death in a strange country in the mountains.”

Antiochus Epiphanes was such an evil man that he waited until God plagued him at the end of his life to say I want to convert and preach the gospel, and the Lord said no. That is the Epiphanes complex the white man has. Black people have been trying to change this white man for centuries, all the way back to Rome and Greece, and he has never changed. He has never dealt favorably toward us, ever. Every few years a Negro says I can change him. God said no: God is not going to change the white man; he is going to kill him.

precepts.why:
What Antiochus did, their forefather Esau did. This is the Epiphanes complex. “Lest there be any fornicator, or profane person, as Esau, who for one morsel of meat sold his birthright”: he did not give a damn about his birthright; it was garbage to him.

“For ye know how that afterward, when he would have inherited the blessing, he was rejected”: God rejected him. “For he found no place of repentance, though he sought it carefully with tears.” F your tears; the Lord does not care. Antiochus was crying, stinking and dying, and God said f your tears, you did so much evil. Now look at this white man today, doing evil worldwide and saying I will be a Christian and love everybody. No.

Their own scholars know who Edom is. Dr. William Smith’s Dictionary of the Bible, published while we were barely out of slavery, says the book of Obadiah is a favorite study of the modern Jews, who read in it the future fate of their own nation and of the Christians: it is a fixed principle of rabbinical interpretation that by Edom is meant Rome, and Kimchi lays it down that all the prophets said of the destruction of Edom in the last times refers to Rome. It says kings who reigned in Italy and built up Rome came from Edom, so that Italy, Greece and all the Western provinces, Germany, France and Britain, became filled with Edomites; that Julius Caesar was called an Edomite, and the Jews believed Titus was an Edomite; and that Janus, the god of Rome and the first king of Latium, was a grandson of Esau. The month of January is named after Janus: according to their own writers, after a grandson of Esau.

We go to the Bible, then to the secondary sources. Read it again: Esau found no place of repentance though he sought it with tears, and it is the same with Antiochus Epiphanes. He sought it with tears, he was plagued, and the Lord said I am not forgiving you. That is Esau’s fate.

sense.text: “For the day of the Lord is near upon all the heathen”: the second coming of Christ. “As thou hast done, it shall be done unto thee”: the way they treated us, God says I am going to do the same thing to them. “Thy reward shall return upon thine own head.”

“For as ye have drunk upon my holy mountain”: this group is Amalek, the so-called Jewish people, drinking on the holy mountain and saying we got the land. Obadiah speaks of both groups: America in verse 4 and these in verse 16.

“So shall all the heathen drink continually, yea, they shall drink, and they shall swallow down, and they shall be as though they had not been.” They shall be as though they never ever existed.
“But upon mount Zion shall be deliverance, and there shall be holiness; and the house of Jacob shall possess their possessions.” We are going to take everything.

“And the house of Jacob shall be a fire”: the kingdom of Judah, that is Judah, Benjamin and Levi. “And the house of Joseph a flame”: the northern kingdom, the ten tribes. “And the house of Esau for stubble”: we are going to burn them up; they will be our firewood. “And devour them; and there shall not be any remaining of the house of Esau.”

“For the Lord hath spoken it.” It is not us being racist; the Lord said that. Christians do not like that one.

precepts.why: “Though thou exalt thyself as the eagle, and though thou set thy nest among the stars.” What group is that talking about? America. Verse 4 is America, and the ones who “have drunk upon my holy mountain” in verse 16 are the so-called Jews: the book of Obadiah speaks of both groups of Edom.

sense.text: “By the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, and by our gathering together unto him.” Our gathering together unto him is what Genesis 49:10 speaks of: unto Christ shall the gathering of the people be. That is what Paul was talking about.

“That ye be not soon shaken in mind, or be troubled, neither by spirit, nor by word, nor by letter as from us, as that the day of Christ is at hand.” Do not let anybody trick you that the second coming has already happened, or that it is near.

“For that day shall not come, except there come a falling away first”: the second coming shall not come until all twelve tribes fall and go into captivity, into slavery.

“And that man of sin be revealed, the son of perdition”: perdition means hell, destruction.

“Who opposeth and exalteth himself above all that is called God”: that is not one guy, that is a race of man. They exalt themselves above everything. In their new movie about David and Goliath they are the Philistines, they are the Israelites, they are everybody.

“Or that is worshipped”: they have everybody worshipping them. “So that he as God sitteth in the temple of God, shewing himself that he is God.” Remember what Epiphanes means: God manifest. Remember the Vicar of Christ: Christ’s replacement on earth. It is the same thing. He says his temples are the temples of God, and they painted Caesar Borgia, Pope Alexander VI and Lucrezia as God, Christ, the angels and the Israelites. Nobody else ever did that but this race.
“Remember ye not, that, when I was yet with you, I told you these things?” Paul was always warning what was going to happen.
“And now ye know what withholdeth”: what is withholding the second coming of Christ. “That he might be revealed in his time”: the white man has to be revealed in his time, and that is this time now.

“For the mystery of iniquity doth already work”: it was already at work, because Rome was in power. “Only he who now letteth will let”: God is the one letting them reign and rule, “until he be taken out of the way.”

“And then shall that Wicked be revealed”: our job, brothers, is to reveal the wicked. Do not care about their feelings being hurt; everybody must know who the wicked is.

“Whom the Lord shall consume with the spirit of his mouth”: the spirit of his mouth is the Bible, and that is what we must use. Not clever speeches, the word of God, so everybody listening sees that what is explained is in the Bible. “And shall destroy with the brightness of his coming”: Christ is going to destroy him.

“Even him, whose coming is after the working of Satan”: our coming is supposed to be after Christ; the white man’s coming and going is after Satan. His politics and his religions are based on Satan.

“With all power and signs and lying wonders”: his scientific and technological advancements, the moon, the nuclear power. The world says only God could get to the moon, surely God is in this white man. No: Satan is dealing with him.

“And with all deceivableness of unrighteousness”: unrighteousness in one word is sin; the white man deceives with sin. “In them that perish”: those appointed to die.

“Because they received not the love of the truth, that they might be saved.” That is our people. The truth is Christ and the keeping of the law, and a lot of these Christians do not want to be saved; they rejected it.

“And for this cause God shall send them strong delusion, that they should believe a lie”: because they reject the truth, Christ and the commandments. That is why they see talking trees and say Mother Mary came down and talked to them; God says let them believe this foolishness. “That they all might be damned who believed not the truth, but had pleasure in unrighteousness”: all our people that reject the truth.

“But we are bound to give thanks alway to God for you”: that is how we feel. We thank God for the brothers and sisters coming into this truth and changing their lives: study, pray, apply. “Because God hath from the beginning chosen you to salvation through sanctification of the Spirit and belief of the truth.” “Whereunto he called you by our gospel”: all of you were called by our gospel, “to the obtaining of the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.”

precepts.why: “The sceptre shall not depart from Judah, nor a lawgiver from between his feet”: King and priest, as Christ is. “Until Shiloh come; and unto him shall the gathering of the people be.” Unto Christ shall the gathering of the people be. That is our “gathering together unto him” that Paul was talking about in Thessalonians.

Here is the precept for the falling away. When Christ was on the scene the southern kingdom was not all in captivity; they had liberty under Rome.

“And they shall fall by the edge of the sword”: by the sword of Rome. “And shall be led away captive into all nations”: led away as slaves into all nations. “And Jerusalem shall be trodden down of the Gentiles”: the white man should take over the land, “until the times of the Gentiles be fulfilled”, until the time of their rulership is up.

So that day shall not come except we fall and go into slavery first, and here we are in slavery.

The man of sin exalts himself above “all that is called God, or that is worshipped”, and that is what was read at the beginning: “And all that dwell upon the earth shall worship him.” Everybody worships the white man as God, as Jesus, as the angels. Everybody worships the white man.

“The mystery of iniquity doth already work”, because Rome was in power during Paul’s time. “And upon her forehead was a name written, MYSTERY, BABYLON THE GREAT, THE MOTHER OF HARLOTS AND ABOMINATIONS OF THE EARTH.” It was starting back then: that was Rome, and every Caesar established himself as God on earth.

“Fear them not therefore: for there is nothing covered, that shall not be revealed.” “What I tell you in darkness, that speak ye in light”: what he told in secret, in parables. “And what ye hear in the ear”: the parables, the allegories, the metaphors. “That preach ye upon the housetops”: make it plain, make it plain.

“And fear not them which kill the body, but are not able to kill the soul”: do not be scared of them; they are going to screw their faces up and get mad at what you are saying, but they cannot kill your soul. “But rather fear him which is able to destroy both soul and body in hell”: you had better fear the Lord.

“Are not two sparrows sold for a farthing? and one of them shall not fall on the ground without your Father.” Nobody dies without the Father saying so. “But the very hairs of your head are all numbered. Fear ye not therefore, ye are of more value than many sparrows.”

“Whosoever therefore shall confess me before men, him will I confess also before my Father which is in heaven.” If we confess Christ in the coming time of tribulation and persecution, he will confess us before the Father. That is how the wicked is revealed: we reveal him with the word, without fear.
